recipe.visualDefinition: A nocturnal urban scene framed by a thick black border, featuring a group of figures standing against a long brick wall illuminated by a warm, low-angle light source, with dark high-rise apartment buildings and a deep blue twilight sky in the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm orange brickwork contrasting against a deep indigo sky
Verticality of the apartment blocks versus the horizontal stretch of the wall
Ghostly, slightly blurred figures suggesting movement or long exposure
Thin white internal frame separating the image from the black outer margin
coreInvariants: Warm artificial lighting on the brick texture
Scattered yellow and red lit windows in the dark buildings

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Figures are positioned in the lower left quadrant at a medium-long scale, dwarfed by the architecture.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit, textured red brick wall spanning the lower half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the bright wall up to the tall building on the left, then across the sky to the smaller building on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial black border and dark sky provide high-contrast negative space for the central image and typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the lit wall and the dark surroundings; saturated red text pops against the black background.

letterConstructionRules: Upper text: Wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif with uniform stroke weight
Lower text: Fluid, slanted cursive script with connected letters and varying stroke thickness
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'M' features a long, sweeping descender
Sans-serif characters have wide apertures and circular 'O's
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, spaced-out sans-serif with a fluid, organic script.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top line
Overlap of script onto the image frame
avoid: Centering the script perfectly without overlap

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Light or ITC Avant Garde
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-tracked uppercase aesthetic
Captures the casual, mid-century cursive feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an urban night scene with a long red brick wall in the foreground lit by warm streetlights. Behind it, a tall dark apartment block with scattered lit windows against a deep blue twilight sky. Include 3-4 figures in 70s attire standing by the wall with a slight motion blur. Frame the entire image with a thin white line and a thick black outer border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a wide-tracked, thin white geometric sans-serif title at the very top. Below it, place a large, vibrant red casual script word that slightly overlaps the top edge of the white inner frame.

verificationChecks: Is the brick wall the brightest element in the image?
Does the script text overlap the white frame line?
Is the sky a deep indigo rather than pitch black?
Is the outer border a solid, heavy black?

adjustableVariables: Density of lit windows in the buildings
Intensity of the motion blur on the figures
Thickness of the white inner frame
Tracking width of the top text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
Exact window patterns on the buildings
Original brand logos or specific artist names

mustAchieve: High contrast between warm artificial light and cool natural dusk

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red script is legible against the black background.
Check that the white frame line is perfectly rectangular and centered.
Verify the figures look like a cohesive group rather than isolated elements.
Confirm the color temperature of the wall is distinctly warm/orange.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Dusk + Brick Wall + High-Rise Silhouette + Geometric/Script Typographic Contrast + Heavy Black Border Frame
